info.title: IMPROJ API
info.description: The IMPROJ public REST API. JSON only. Authenticate with a personal access token (improj_pat_...) or an organisation token (improj_org_...) in the Authorization header as a Bearer token. Every request acts as the token's owner with exactly the permissions the owner has in the app, narrowed by the token's scopes and limits. Rate limits per minute: 300 requests and 60 writes per token, 30 uploads per token, 600 per client address. Errors are RFC 7807 application/problem+json with a stable code. Lists are cursor paginated.

tags.name: Projects

tags.name: Tasks
tags.description: Tasks you can see in a project; create, change and delete them where the app lets you.

tags.name: Members
tags.description: People on a project. Email addresses follow each person's privacy setting.

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Project files and folders, short-lived download links, and the two-step upload.

tags.name: Calendar
tags.description: Project calendar events, and your own calendar across projects.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Webhook endpoints, test pings and the delivery log. Events themselves are described under webhooks.

tags.name: AI agents
tags.description: AI agents you report to (Enterprise). These routes keep the camelCase shape they were published with.

get.description: Scope: `agent:read`. Enterprise AI agents only; not gated by the API plan feature. Fields are camelCase (the shape this route was published with).

Scope: `agent:read`. Enterprise AI agents only; not gated by the API plan feature. This route keeps the shape it was first published with, so existing clients keep working: camelCase item fields, a numeric nextCursor, and limit 1 to 50 (default 20). It also returns next_cursor, signed like every other list; new clients should page with next_cursor (passed back as ?cursor=) and ignore nextCursor.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: The AI agent's id.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Where the next page starts. Pass next_cursor (opaque, signed; preferred). The legacy numeric nextCursor is still accepted.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page, 1 to 50 (default 20). This route keeps its own limits.

next_cursor.description: Use this. Opaque, signed cursor of the next page, passed back as ?cursor=; null on the last page.

nextCursor.description: Legacy: the id after which the next page starts, also accepted as ?cursor=. Kept for existing clients; new clients use next_cursor.

x-legacy-shape.reason: Published before the snake_case conventions; kept for backward compatibility with existing Enterprise agent clients.

bearerAuth.description: Scopes: user:read (Your profile), projects:read (Projects), tasks:read (Read tasks), tasks:write (Write tasks), milestones:read (Read milestones), milestones:write (Write milestones), members:read (Members), files:read (Read files), files:write (Upload files), calendar:read (Read calendar), calendar:write (Write calendar), meetings:read (Meetings), webhooks:manage (Webhooks), agent:read (AI agents: read), agent:note (AI agents: note)

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a POST safe to retry for 24 hours: the same key with the same request returns the first answer (with Idempotent-Replayed: true). The same key with a different request: 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; while the first is still running: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_USE.

ApiVersion.name: IMPROJ-API-Version
ApiVersion.description: The API version the client was written for. Optional; without it the current version (2026-10-24) answers. An unsupported value: 400 API_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Your own id for this request, 8 to 64 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -. It is echoed back in X-Request-Id and in a problem's request_id; anything else is replaced by a generated req_... id.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed in the tightest window that applied.

X-Request-Id.description: The request's id: the X-Request-Id you sent when it was valid, else a generated req_... id. Quote it when you contact support.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present on a POST answered from the stored first answer of the same Idempotency-Key.

Allow.description: The methods this path takes, for example GET, POST.

BadRequest.description: Invalid input (code INVALID_INPUT, with errors[]), a bad cursor (API_CURSOR_INVALID), an unsupported IMPROJ-API-Version (API_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED), a token sent in the query string, or another coded refusal (for example FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED, API_UPLOAD_SIZE_MISMATCH, WEBHOOK_URL_INVALID).

Unauthorized.description: API_TOKEN_MISSING or API_TOKEN_INVALID: no token, or the token is not valid, expired or revoked, or its owner can no longer use it.

Forbidden.description: Missing scope (API_SCOPE_MISSING), IP or origin not allowed, not in the plan (API_NOT_IN_PLAN), API switched off (API_DISABLED), storage full (STORAGE_QUOTA_FULL), or the app refuses this action (viewer, archived project...).

NotFound.description: NOT_FOUND: no such path or resource, or not visible to the token's owner (indistinguishable on purpose). API_UPLOAD_EXPIRED for an upload id that is unknown, used or older than 15 minutes.

MethodNotAllowed.description: API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: the path exists but not with this method. Allow lists the methods it takes.

Conflict.description: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_USE: a request with this Idempotency-Key is still running (POST); or a coded conflict raised by the app.

PayloadTooLarge.description: API_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: the JSON body is over 256 KB (4 KB for an agent note); FILE_TOO_LARGE_FOR_PLAN: the file is larger than the plan allows per file.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: API_UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Content-Type is not application/json (the upload PUT: application/octet-stream or the announced type), or Content-Encoding is not identity.

UnprocessableContent.description: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: this Idempotency-Key was used with a different request (POST); or a coded precondition raised by the app (for example an agent note about a project the agent does not read).

InternalError.description: SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG. Nothing from the failure is shown; quote X-Request-Id to support. A POST with an Idempotency-Key may be retried with the same key.

ServiceUnavailable.description: DB_UNAVAILABLE: the database cannot be reached right now. Retry later.

UploadServiceUnavailable.description: DB_UNAVAILABLE, or SERVER_BUSY when too many uploads are being received at once: retry after Retry-After seconds.

code.description: Stable error code (for example INVALID_INPUT, NOT_FOUND, RATE_LIMITED). Branch on this, not on detail.

description.description: Returned by getTask, createTask and updateTask (null when empty); left out of listTasks.

email.description: Shown only when the person lets other members see it (the app's email privacy setting).

time_zone.description: IANA zone of the wall clock times (null: floating local time).

recurrence.description: RFC 5545 RRULE of a repeating event.

url.description: Shown masked: host and the start of the path.

source.description: Where the item comes from: personal, project_event, activity, meeting_note, meeting, reminder, milestone, poll, task or external.

project.description: null for a personal item (never sent to a limited or organisation token).

principal.description: Whether you are one of the people the agent reports to.

kind.description: One of: briefing, report, alert, forecast, analysis, draft, proposal, note, tuning, answer, notice.

notice.description: The AI notice to show next to the item.

id.description: evt_<number>, stable across retries of the same event.

data.description: Ids only. A ping carries {object: "ping"}; member ids are strings.

object.description: task, milestone, file, member, calendar_event, project or ping.
